name: Lead Ops - GHL intake, AI qualification, routing

nodes.name: Process Lead (service)
nodes.notes: neverError is deliberate: the service answers 202 for a retryable failure and 400 for a bad payload, and we branch on that ourselves rather than letting n8n abort the execution and lose the distinction.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ calendarId: $env.GHL_CALENDAR_ID, locationId: $env.GHL_LOCATION_ID, contactId: $json.contactId, title: 'Site visit - ' + String($json.summary).slice(0, 60), appointmentStatus: 'new' }) }}

nodes.name: Book Appointment Slot
nodes.notes: Disabled by default. This is the one node that needs a real, paid GHL location; everything else in this workflow runs against the local mock. Enable it after filling in GHL_CALENDAR_ID and the credential.

nodes.name: Wait and Redeliver
nodes.notes: Safe to loop back into the service because the idempotency key is unchanged: completed steps are memoized, so the retry resumes rather than re-creating the contact.
